prompt: Which employee is included in the intended audience?
promptZh: 哪一種員工屬於課程對象？

options.text: A customer seeking a public product demonstration
options.zh: 尋求公開產品展示的客戶
options.whyZh: 這是內部員工訓練，不是公開展示。

options.text: Only employees who build three-dimensional models
options.zh: 僅限建立三維模型的員工
options.whyZh: 課程不教三維建模，目的是圖面管制。

options.text: Only a designer with advanced CAD skills
options.zh: 僅限具進階 CAD 技能的設計師
options.whyZh: 課程不要求 CAD 經驗，對象也不限設計師。

options.text: A purchaser who sends drawings to suppliers
options.zh: 將圖面寄給供應商的採購人員
options.whyZh: 備忘錄特別將這類採購同仁列入對象。

explanationZh: 備忘錄特別將這類採購同仁列入對象。
evidence: including purchasing staff who send drawings to suppliers
